{{Top|leg}}
According to the [[Below the Belt: Philosophy|philosophy]] of the [[Bilar]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the '''overmind''' was a metaphorical [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]] (or ''claqa'') that encompassed all members of the Bilar species. This concept extended the close ties that bound individual constituents of ''claqa''&mdash;groups of Bilars who shared a common intelligence and personality&mdash;to the species as a whole. Thus, the overmind concept prevented a Bilar ''claqa'' from engaging in violent behavior against another ''claqa''.<ref name="GG4b ">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
